notes: A public-API translation of the native-green 50-assertion HLA_EVOKED saved-live-TSO-retraction-record case. A constrained receiver has a timestamp-six ordinary interaction queued when two members complete an untimed save. The publisher then retracts the saved designator and observes its terminal state; restoration must roll back that post-save terminal ledger. Flush Queue Request delivers the saved interaction and same public designator before its grant. Retraction becomes legal again after restore, invokes Request Retraction, and terminalizes a second time. This behavior is distinct from the existing timed-federation-save-restore scenario, which does not retract the live designator between save and restore. Isolated C++ primary/contract passed using only the installed 2026-10-20 package libraries with integer64 and float64 time. The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 interaction FOM and parameter, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, durable/process-boundary restore, interoperability, and conformance are unverified.
